name: ROUNDABOUT_YELLOW_DIAMOND

w2-7_roundabout.desc: roundabout: three clockwise curved arrows on construction circles R312 (outer), R285, R215, R189 (inner); arrowheads with R10 barbs, dims 64 / 55 / 42 / 40 / 57 at the left arrowhead, 2.5 deg offset at the bottom. Symbol viewBox must be the full 624 square about the rotation centre (the artwork does not fill it symmetrically: measured extents -318..+288 x, -304..+286 y).

notes: Diamond 750 side drawn as bounding square 750*sqrt2 = 1060.66 (centre 530.33); R50 outer, 10 yellow edge, 30 black border (as drawing). Symbol centred on both centrelines (drawing). Box = the R312 construction circle square (624) centred; tracer must use that square as the viewBox so the centre lands on the sign centre. QA: box set to the drawn ink extent about the sign centre (318 left, 286 right, 304 above, 286 below; measured on the illustration) because the tracer's viewBox is the ink extent, not the R312 construction square; the arrows' extents are not dimensioned.
